name: Default
shortDescription: Automated yt-dlp downloads of channels, playlists and music into Plex, Jellyfin, Emby and Kodi ready libraries, managed from a browser-based VS Code editor.

alerts.message: Log in with the generated PASSWORD value from this app's environment settings. The editor includes a terminal into the container, so keep that password private.

Nothing downloads automatically until you edit /config/ytdl-sub-configs/cron in the editor and enable the ytdl-sub sub command. Test your subscriptions with a dry run first to avoid throttles or bans.
